children: ICICI Securities research report on Whirlpool of India

Takeaways: (1) Other income to PBT was ~47% in FY26. The valuation multiple (P/E) based on core business earnings, i.e., excluding cash and tax-adjusted other income, stood at 48x on FY26 earnings. (2) Revenue grew 1.4% YoY in FY26; however, EBITDA/PAT declined 12.6%/8.9% YoY due to weak summers and intense competitive activity. (3) It launched several new products across categories and expanded its existing product lines. (4) It continued to invest in product innovation, with R&D spends rising 93.9% YoY, while ad-spends increased 8% YoY. (5) P4G productivity initiatives helped offset a meaningful portion of inflationary and regulatory cost pressures; however, energy-transition costs and higher e-waste provisions impacted margins.
We maintain REDUCE with a DCF-based unchanged TP of INR 730 (implied target P/E at 22x FY28E EPS).
